keyword: where to watch phillies vs san francisco giants
claims: The Philadelphia Phillies play the San Francisco Giants at Oracle Park, San Francisco, CA on Monday, April 6, 2026, at 9:45 p.m. ET (6:45 p.m. PT).
The game is available on TV via NBC Sports Bay Area (Giants) and NBC Sports Philadelphia+ (Phillies).
The game is available via streaming on FuboTV, Hulu, YouTube TV, Peacock (NBC Sports Bay Area/Philadelphia+), and MLB.TV (outside market).
The game is available on radio via 94 WIP (PHI) and KNBR 680 AM/104.5 FM (SF).
